test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I will / be in school / for / 7 a.m. to 2 p.m.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**for**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**from**' should be used instead of '**for**'.
 
• In the given sentence*** 'from...to' ***makes a pair. It is 'used to show the level at which a range of things begins, such as numbers, time or prices'.
 
 
• *Example: Tickets will cost** from $10 to $45.***
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I will be in school **from** 7 a.m. to 2 p.m.*
